description_en: Queries the results of applying a firewall template to instances
description_zh: 查询防火墙模板应用实例结果
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open describe-firewall-template-apply-results --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --firewall-template-id ft-bcf1a7hrdq7170000 --task-id aft-ikgt0bynitvs30000 --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeFirewallTemplateApplyResults

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the simple application server. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html to query the list of supported Alibaba Cloud regions
parameters.help_zh:
指定的轻量应用服务器实例所属的地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查看支持的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. A client token is generated from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. The value of ClientToken can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the template application task
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the firewall rule list
parameters.help_zh: 防火墙规则列表的页码
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数。默认值：20
parameters.name: page_size

PageNumber.description_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query
PageNumber.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Default value: 20
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数。默认值：20

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of firewall rules

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the firewall template application task was executed, in the format of EEE MMM dd HH:mm:ss zzz yyyy
CreateTime.description_zh: 防火墙模板应用执行时间，格式为 EEE MMM dd HH:mm:ss zzz yyyy

FailedCount.description_en: The total number of instances to which the firewall template failed to be applied
FailedCount.description_zh: 防火墙模板应用失败总数

InstanceApplyResults.description_en: The results of applying the firewall template to instances

items.description_en: The results of applying the firewall template to instances

InstanceId.description_en: The simple application server instance ID

Status.description_en:
The status of applying the firewall template to a specific instance. Valid values:

Running: The firewall template is being applied.
Failed: The firewall template failed to be applied.
Success: The firewall template was applied.
PartFailed: The firewall template was partially applied. Some rules failed
Status.description_zh:
防火墙模板应用到某个实例的状态。可能值：

Running：防火墙模板正在应用中。
Failed：防火墙模板应用全部失败。
Success：防火墙模板应用成功。
PartFailed：防火墙模板应用部分失败，有部分实例应用失败

Status.description_en:
The status of applying the firewall template to all instances. Valid values:

Running: The firewall template is being applied.
Failed: The firewall template failed to be applied to all instances.
Success: The firewall template was applied.
PartFailed: The firewall template was partially applied. Some instances failed
Status.description_zh:
防火墙模板应用到全部实例的状态。可能值：

Running：防火墙模板正在应用中。
Failed：防火墙模板应用全部失败。
Success：防火墙模板应用成功。
PartFailed：防火墙模板应用部分失败，有部分实例应用失败

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the template application task

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of instances to which the firewall template is applied
